title: Cost Elements — Create / Edit
overviewHtml: An extra accounting dimension, such as a department code or activity, set on wage accounts and employee account assignments. Its code is written onto payroll journal lines alongside the account. The type cannot be blank.

fields.label: Code
fields.rules: Optional. Left blank, the next number is assigned when the record is saved. Must be unique in this list.
fields.html:
What it is. A short code that identifies this item in its list.

Example. 001

fields.label: NameEn
fields.rules: Required. Must be unique in this list.
fields.html: What it is. The item's name in English.

fields.label: NameAr
fields.rules: Required. Must be unique in this list.
fields.html: What it is. The item's name in Arabic.

fields.label: CostElementType
fields.rules: Optional. Chosen from Cost Element Type master data.
fields.html:
What it is. The kind of dimension.

Example. Department
